summary: Proposal to replace the standard gocql driver with ScyllaDB's GoCQL fork (v1.18) to improve Temporal Server performance. Benchmarks show +8.2% throughput improvement and 20.5% reduction in memory allocations, though support for Cassandra 3.x would be dropped.
userImpact: Users running Temporal Server will experience improved throughput and reduced memory consumption, leading to better scalability and lower infrastructure costs.
rootCause: Standard gocql driver has inefficient buffer reuse, frame allocation patterns, and metrics caching that result in high memory allocations and GC overhead.
proposedFix: Replace github.com/gocql/gocql with github.com/scylladb/gocql v1.18.0 via go.mod replace directive; the ScyllaDB fork is a drop-in replacement maintaining API compatibility.
keyQuote: Switching from upstream github.com/gocql/gocql v1.7.0 to github.com/scylladb/gocql v1.18.0 yields +8.2% throughput
